It is easier to urbanize a desert when water is planned, though not always.
Is it easier to urbanize a jungle or to urbanize a desert?

Jungle land has roots, mud, and animals that raise clearing costs.
Water shortage in arid places often matters more than extra vegetation removal.
So a dry site can become a city if pipes, power, and shade are added.
A giraffe near a new road can mark that open terrain was shaped first.
